features.name: Copilot Studio Agent Building
features.description: Maker experience for creating agents without coding that can be deployed across multiple channels including Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger.

features.name: MCP Server for Business Central
features.description: New technology allowing agents to operate on Business Central data more easily, added to Business Central in a previous wave as preview and facilitating agent communication with Business Central.

features.name: Business Central Power Platform Connector
features.description: Special connector for Business Central that enables agents to talk to Business Central APIs with extra functionality for agent interaction.

features.name: Copilot Studio Agent Knowledge Sources
features.description: Agents can be configured with natural language instructions, business documentation, web knowledge sources, and multiple tool types including flows and MCP servers.

features.name: Copilot Studio Multi-Tool Support
features.description: Agents can use different tool types including connector tools, custom prompts, Power Automate flows, and MCP protocol to interact with Business Central and other services.
caveats: Agent decides which tool to use based on request

features.name: Publishing Agents to Multiple Channels
features.description: Agents built in Copilot Studio can be published to Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, email, and text messaging.

features.name: Copilot Studio Licensing Model
features.description: Copilot Studio uses Copilot credits as currency for agent usage, separate from general Power Platform usage rights included in Business Central license. Credits are shared across all agents in Power Platform.
